name: British Columbia Institute of Technology
description: The British Columbia Institute of Technology is an educational institution in Vancouver, the capital city of British Columbia, that has been training experts, professionals and innovators to shape the economy since 1964. British Columbia Institute of Technology is founded on its educational strategy to go beyond textbooks and classrooms. BCIT students gain the technical skills, real-world experience and problem-solving ability necessary to lead innovation in the rapidly changing business world. Through close collaboration with industry, graduates achieve global success through the British Columbia Institute of Technology network. BCIT offers different program alternatives, from diplomas and certificates to undergraduate and graduate degrees.
